parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue but may introduce unintended side effects.

issues.description: The change modifies the `pytest_runtest_makereport` hook, which could potentially affect other parts of the test reporting mechanism. There is a risk of introducing behavioral regressions that are not covered by the existing tests.
The PR does not include any new tests to verify that the change does not break other scenarios involving test skipping and reporting. This increases the risk of regressions in the future.
